title: A Design Project Definition for Grid Enhancement Technology: Maximizing Transmission Power Delivery via Dynamic Line Rating
summary: Project definition for a Dynamic Line Rating system replacing static transmission line ratings, covering standards, UI, and I/O specifications.
notes: No ADR frontmatter/status or Decision/Consequences sections; no PRD-style user stories or acceptance criteria. Dominant signals are technical specifications: UI Specifications, Operating Environment Specifications, Performance Specifications, and an Input/Output Specification table with concrete ranges, plus applicable IEEE/NERC standards. Also contains PRD-like 'Project Deliverables' and DOC-like team organization/policy sections, but per precedence rule (SPEC > PRD > DOC) and the strength/specificity of the I/O and technical spec content, classified as SPEC.
